title_as_printed: Cerebral amyloid accumulation is associated with distinct structural and functional alterations in the brain of depressed elders with mild cognitive impairment

correct_pdf.title_as_printed: Functional connectivity differences in Alzheimer's disease and amnestic mild cognitive impairment associated with AT(N) classification and anosognosia
correct_pdf.citation: Mondragon JD, Maurits NM, De Deyn PP, for ADNI. Neurobiology of Aging 101 (2021) 22-39. doi 10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2020.12.021

blind_codes.Sample_N: 121 in FC analysis (26 HC + 78 aMCI + 17 AD); 143 eligible; 73 in anosognosia analysis

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: 121 for FC analysis; 73 for anosognosia analysis

Task_Type.reason: Judged against the correct PDF (Mondragon 2021); page numbers are pages of that PDF. The study compares functional connectivity between groups defined by AT(N) biomarker profile and runs a voxel-wise regression on anosognosia. There is no classifier or discrimination figure.
Task_Type.quote: We assessed local functional coupling and between-network connectivity through between-group intrinsic local correlation and independent component analyses.

Category.reason: The primary domain is imaging: rs-fMRI, plus amyloid PET and FDG-PET for A and N. The registry carries it. CSF p-tau, which supplies the T of the AT(N) grouping, is a secondary C3 domain the registry omits.
Category.quote: As ADNI participants did not undergo PET imaging for tau in the ADNI-2 and ADNI-GO study phases, tau burden “T” was assessed by using CSF p-tau levels in this study.

Validation_Type.reason: No predictive model; the analyses are group comparisons and regressions.
Validation_Type.quote: For voxel-level measurements, two-sample paired t-tests were performed on mean regional activation maps to assess between-group differences

Sample_N_Approx.reason: The FC analysis used 121 participants (26 HC + 78 aMCI + 17 AD) out of 143 eligible; the anosognosia analysis used 73. The registry gives both figures.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: One hundred and twenty-one and 73 participants were included in the FC and the anosognosia analysis, respectively.

Publication_Year.reason: Available online 8 January 2021; Neurobiology of Aging 101 (2021).

ADNI_Dependent.quote: Data were obtained from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) database
